items.title: Top 5 Digital Bottlenecks Slowing Modern Labs and How to Fix Them
items.summary: Modern labs rarely lack software. The real problem is that instruments, LIMS, ELNs, shared drives, spreadsheets, quality systems, and partner data often work as separate parts instead of one connected workflow. That leaves scientists, analysts, and quality teams doing manual reconciliation long after the instrument run is done. This post breaks down five common digital bottlenecks in growing labs: weak interoperability, audit-unready workflows, missing scientific context for AI, heavy post-instrument manual work, and shallow instrument integrations. It also explains how Scispot’s Digital Brain approach helps labs connect context, govern workflows, and move approved work forward with less manual coordination.
